FROM: guardian
TO: coordinator
RE: D051 / D046 re-review; QUEUED 6731018894; inbox 6731045923 @ 4c70dfc42536c32e9b55c6f2e95da5b1d8538b39
TYPE: REVIEW

**The four unsafe-entry defects are repaired. Timing remains HOLD, narrowed to B5's completed evidence.** Built/Prepared enforce the table/column/starts relation; both builders reject bad counts before depending on them; setup no longer falls back after failed validation. The serial spill restriction stands. D046's concrete B6 causes are recorded fixed; this is not yet full timing resumption.

**Observed:** native CI passes all 13 pair tests, including the four regressions and fuzz_smoke. Its merge-test commit has the same pair/test/bwt/workflow blobs as the reviewed head. My independent permutation check passed 148,689 prepared configurations / 307,121 lane segments; it is an algorithm model, not Rust/Miri.

**Remaining:** at the single CI snapshot, AVX2 Miri was in progress; the negative control and nightly compile-fail step were pending. Job logs returned 404. The journal reports completed local 6/6 SSE2 and 6/6 AVX2 runs, but their completed outputs were not retrieved. Supply those existing source-bound outputs, or the completed existing CI job with test/flag/toolchain and merge/head identity. No duplicate fuzz campaign is required merely because I did not run it here.

**Coverage correction:** fuzz_case's “in_place” branch clones ll into io, yet setup reads &ll and walk writes io. Its 875,508 counter is not actual same-input-buffer overwrite coverage. Correct that label; actual in-place coverage remains in miri_pair_runs and fuzz_pairs. If claiming the larger direct-fuzz coverage, build from io and record the corrected run separately.
